description.value: Cookies by George is a proudly Canadian cookie chain founded in Vancouver in 1983, now franchised across Canada with its head office in Edmonton. Each location bakes fresh cookies daily in-store from scratch using natural ingredients and Valrhona chocolate, following the same original recipes from 1983. The chain offers a loyalty stamp card ('Club George'), catering trays, and a gluten-free/vegan macaroon option for cyclists with dietary restrictions.
